Fit the unified multirates model.

Source: R/fitters.R
fit_multirates.Rd

Compiles and runs inst/multirates_positive_s.stan on a PEPI_Multirates object built with init_multirates().

Usage

fit_multirates(
  x,
  cmdstan_path = cmdstanr::cmdstan_path(),
  seed = 45,
  ndraws = 1000,
  chains = 4,
  parallel_chains = 4,
  adapt_delta = 0.99,
  max_treedepth = 15,
  init = NULL,
  mu = 1e-07,
  l = 2.7e+09,
  t_min = 0,
  ms_epi = 0,
  sigma_epi = 0.5,
  alpha_lambda = 1,
  beta_lambda = 1,
  alpha_n_wt = 1,
  beta_n_wt = 10,
  alpha_p_wt = 1,
  beta_p_wt = 10,
  min_kappa = 10,
  max_kappa = 1000,
  min_sigma_count = 0.01,
  max_sigma_count = 1,
  include_poisson = 1L,
  include_poisson_driver = include_poisson,
  include_poisson_driver_n = include_poisson,
  include_poisson_driver_p = include_poisson,
  include_poisson_dc = 1L,
  include_trunk = 1L
)

Arguments

x

PEPI_Multirates object.

cmdstan_path

String specifying the path to the cmdstan installation.

seed

Seed of the computation.

ndraws

Number of posterior draws.

chains

Number of MCMC chains.

parallel_chains

Number of parallel MCMC chains.

adapt_delta

Target average acceptance probability.

max_treedepth

Maximum number of trajectory steps the NUTS sampler can take per iteration.

init

List of initialization values, or NULL to use a built-in default (see .multirates_default_init()).

mu

Mutation rate per division per bp per allele.

l

Length of the genome.

t_min

Lower bound for the tmrca prior.

ms_epi, sigma_epi

Lognormal prior hyperparameters for s_epi.

alpha_lambda, beta_lambda

Gamma prior hyperparameters for lambda_n.

alpha_n_wt, beta_n_wt, alpha_p_wt, beta_p_wt

Gamma prior hyperparameters for the wt switch rates omega_n_wt/omega_p_wt.

min_kappa, max_kappa

Uniform prior bounds for kappa.

min_sigma_count, max_sigma_count

Uniform prior bounds for sigma_count.

include_poisson

Default (0/1) of the Poisson terms on the driver mutations, used by the per-type switches below when they are not given.

include_poisson_driver, include_poisson_driver_n, include_poisson_driver_p

Switches (0/1) of the Poisson term on the mutations of the driver, driver_n and driver_p populations (for driver_p, an upper bound).

include_poisson_dc

Switch (0/1) of the Poisson term on the driver mutations of the dc populations; the clade terms are always included.

include_trunk

Switch (0/1) of the trunk regularization of tmrca.

Value

PEPI_Multirates object with `inference$multirates`, `stan_data$multirates` and `index_maps` populated.

Examples

# \donttest{
source(system.file("examples", "tables_example.R", package = "PEPI"))
x = fit_multirates(x, seed = 31, chains = 2, parallel_chains = 2, ndraws = 200,
  init = rep(list(list(omega_p_wt = 3e-3, omega_p_driver = 3e-3)), 2),
  mu = mu$mean, l = 51e06, t_min = -20, ms_epi = -0.8, sigma_epi = 0.9,
  alpha_lambda = 10, beta_lambda = 10, alpha_n_wt = 1, beta_n_wt = 1e4,
  alpha_p_wt = 0.2, beta_p_wt = 10, min_kappa = 3000, max_kappa = 5000,
  min_sigma_count = 0.05, max_sigma_count = 0.15, include_poisson = 1, include_trunk = 0)
